about.label: About
about.title: Professional Mobile App Developer
about.body1: My name is Zaid, and I am a Mobile Application developer with over a year of experience in mobile application development. I have a strong proficiency in the use of the Flutter framework, allowing me to create efficient, beautiful, and highly functional mobile applications.
about.body2: My experience spans various aspects of app development, including UI/UX design, state management, API integration, and performance optimization. I excel at turning complex requirements into user-friendly applications, ensuring a seamless user experience.
about.body3: In addition to my technical skills, I am passionate about learning and staying up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in mobile development. This drive allows me to incorporate cutting-edge features and best practices into my projects, delivering top-notch applications.

h1.d: Successfully worked on multiple projects, collaborating with teams and clients.

h2.d: Commitment to quality and attention to detail ensures highest standards.

h3.d: Incorporating cutting-edge features and best practices into every project.
